declare-backlog.ts documents this as deliberate: the table only covers the 20 Mersenne exponents proven complete (no possibility of an undiscovered smaller one), and explicitly declines rather than search past it. Wolfram asserts completeness through the 50th (GIMPS-verified); extending our table is a data-provenance question for whoever owns completeness verification, not a lane bug fix — respecting the existing documented judgment rather than overriding it.
